Definition: by variation for a derivative from κνάπτω (to tease cloth); a cloth-dresser:--fuller.
BiblicalUsage: The word gnapheús carries the sense of fuller. In Mark 9:3, the text says "so as no fuller on earth can white them."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of gnapheús I do not force more than it gives: fuller.
